next.reason: §1985:XIII.3.22.3 SR1: 'A signed numeric literal must have associated with it a signed numeric PICTURE character-string'; a numeric-edited report item took only a nonnumeric literal (§1985:XIII.3.22.4 GR1 b). §2023:13.18.63.3 SR3 lets the subject be 'either a signed numeric data item or a numeric-edited data item with a representation of a sign', and §2023:13.18.63.3 SR6 lets numeric literals be used for numeric-edited items in formats 1, 2 and 4 (format 4 is the report section). A signed numeric literal for a signed numeric-edited report item, refused in 1985, is accepted: looser. Compile-time in both.
